description: A dictated capture as speech-to-text writes it: fillers, repeats, no punctuation, the title being the first words said.

fragments.title: Leggy tomato seedlings
fragments.body: Stretched thin and pale on the kitchen sill. Moved them under the grow light at 10 cm, 14 h a day, and they thickened up within a week.

fragments.body: okay so um the tomato starts are doing the the thing again where they go all tall and floppy and kind of yellowish like they're reaching for something i dunno maybe the the window is not enough this time of year
